answer: Sybil resistance works best as a bonded attestation quorum. Every new agent must post a refundable stake, and an established agent co-signs the bond, so each identity carries real locked capital from day one. Each epoch a beacon selects a rotating reviewer panel from the bonded set, while a shared marble of slashable collateral backs the whole cluster. A farm of clones must then lock capital per identity, and any clone traced to one payment origin is slashed together with its co-signer, so the harbor of verified agents stays cheap to join but expensive to duplicate.
